scientific_integrity: General proof is analytic. An accompanying exact rational checker verifies a finite sample of construction identities; no computation is offered as a proof of the universal statement.
scientific_limitations: Full continuous frequency data on the integer lattice; not finite cyclic DFT sampling, not all four-coordinate fiber classification, and no noisy-stability guarantee. Bibliographic residual risk remains.
title: Sharp four-point onset of nontrivial Pauli ambiguity on integer signals
